2. Whether the actual finite marks are divisors on the two-dimensional Cayley-Menger residue surface, while the elliptic curve is the anticanonical infinity boundary/Gysin quotient, so a naive punctured-elliptic full-object model is mistyped.

7. Classification discipline: do not call Q=0 proved coefficient support; do not infer a new carrier cell; do not conflate graph H_1 with elliptic H^1. Assess whether H2 survives and in what refined form.

Return a concise hostile-review packet with: PASS/FAIL per point; any concrete corrections required before ledger recording; strongest justified claim; prohibited stronger claims; and the single next finite falsifier. Cite exact file/equation/worker evidence.
